clusters.name: spike-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: A GO/NO-GO spike that must complete and be reviewed before any parser coding; nothing else may start until its finding lands. If the live /models endpoint does not expose per-tier maxes, the impl member surfaces kind=question and stops.

clusters.name: protocol-foundation
clusters.executionModeRationale: Touches the shared protocol metadata types every later story builds on; must land alone before parser/resolution.

clusters.name: parse-and-resolve
clusters.executionModeRationale: Disjoint crates (model-provider vs models-manager) consuming the US-002 types; safe to run in parallel. US-003 also depends on the spike-gate finding. US-004 additionally owns stale-tier normalization.

clusters.name: config-persistence
clusters.executionModeRationale: Touches the global config schema (generated artifact + deny_unknown_fields) AND the profile config (parity for profile-selected models); must run serially to avoid schema drift conflicts.

clusters.name: tui-picker
clusters.executionModeRationale: The convergence-seam refactor + new picker depend on the persisted config key and tier metadata; serial after config. Owns the operator UX (model->effort->context, single-tier skip) and the picker-skip-on-stale-config test.

clusters.name: thread-sync
clusters.executionModeRationale: Active-thread sync touches the enumerated v2 thread DTOs + generated fixtures (just write-app-server-schema; cargo check does NOT catch fixture drift) + the app-server/core wiring; runs serially after the picker.

clusters.name: docs-registration
clusters.executionModeRationale: Patch-surface §14/§15 registration must reflect EVERY landed upstream-canonical edit, including the final US-007 protocol edits. Split into its own final-only cluster strictly depends-on US-007 so docs cannot race the protocol edits under --parallel.
